subject: general
question: Who won the women's singles title at the US Open 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Iga Swiatek**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iga Sviatek defeated Ons Jabeur of Tunisia to win the US Open 2022.**
 
• Two-time French Open champion Swiatek defeated Ons Jabeur in straight sets** 6-2, 7-6(5) in the final to win her third Grand Slam title.**
 
• Sviatek had never advanced past the fourth round at the US Open.
 
• In July, Sviatek came to Flushing Meadows with a 4-4 record after a 37-match winning streak ended.
 
• **Iga Sviatek is a Polish professional tennis player.**
 
 
• She is currently ranked world No. 1 by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• US Open Tennis Championships

 
 
• The US Open Tennis Championships is a hardcourt tennis tournament.
 
• It is held every year in Queens, New York.
 
• Since 1987, the US Open has been chronologically the fourth and final Grand Slam tournament of the year.
 
• Founded - 1881
 
• **The other three, in chronological order, are**
 
 
• The Australian Open,
 
• French Open and
 
• Wimbledon.
